name: me.shouheng.uix.pages.lock.LockActivity
description: Android UIX (Shouheng88) shows a screen for creating, entering, or resetting the app’s lock code. Depending on the app’s setup and device, it can also ask the user to confirm identity with biometrics or another device check.
disableEffect: The app’s lock-code setup, entry, or reset flow will not open.
